prompt.purpose: Independent mathematical failure audit of the five new finite probes in 92.zip

Alfsen-Shultz.measured_claim_that_survives: On Herm3(C), one generator Da=(i/2)[a,.] yields Jordan derivation residual exactly 0 on a fixed 9-element basis while the wrong anticommutator residual is 1.414; on H3(O) one naive matrix commutator yields sampled residual 143.654 over 36 random pairs; one pair commutator [La,Lb] yields sampled residual 1.9e-13.
Alfsen-Shultz.strongest_kill: No span of any collection of pair commutators is computed, no correspondence axioms are checked, no quantification over all observables is performed, no flow is constructed, and the residual>1 threshold is scale-sensitive.
Alfsen-Shultz.theorem_gap: Single-generator residuals and one low residual on a pair do not establish non-existence of single-observable dynamical correspondence nor any generation statement for a 52-dimensional algebra.

L5_Schmidt_shells.measured_claim_that_survives: Inside the restricted family cos(a)|00>+sin(a)|11>, the marginal Bloch radius decreases monotonically from 1 to 0 while von Neumann entropy increases from 0 to 1; two distinct entangled parameter values produce two distinct radii; the ad-hoc quantity 2*pi*(ri-rj) vanishes on identical parameters and is nonzero on distinct parameters.
L5_Schmidt_shells.strongest_kill: The quantity called Phi is only a rescaled radius difference; no tori, no set inclusions, no generic Schmidt orbit, no connection, no holonomy, and no independent geometric object are ever constructed.
L5_Schmidt_shells.theorem_gap: A 1-parameter radius-versus-entropy correlation plus a trivial difference test supplies no support for any shell structure or any flux.

L6_BKM.measured_claim_that_survives: Spectral BKM quadratic form and a finite-difference Umegaki Hessian differ by approximately 6e-8 on one tested state/tangent pair; one depolarizing map contracts a numerical value from 4.49 to 2.07; a non-CPTP affine state map applied to a tangent fails to preserve the trace-zero condition.
L6_BKM.strongest_kill: No connection form and no curvature tensor are computed; an arc-length ratio extracted from a 1-dimensional family is coordinate-dependent and cannot be called intrinsic curvature; filename claims a connection while source code explicitly does not compute one.
L6_BKM.theorem_gap: Pointwise numerical agreement of quadratic forms plus one contraction example do not establish any connection or any curvature on the state space.

Petz_DPI.measured_claim_that_survives: One lossy qubit channel produces no Umegaki DPI violations on 200 random pairs; unitaries versus that same lossy channel yield binary correlation 1.0 between equality cases and Petz recoverability; four quasi-entropies all decrease along a replacement channel to a chosen fixed point.
Petz_DPI.strongest_kill: The write-up simultaneously treats Umegaki as one member of a family and concludes it is forced; missing are non-operator-convex counter-examples, non-unitary equality-preserving channels, support-boundary tests, and any terrain-derived maps.
Petz_DPI.theorem_gap: Finite sampling on a single channel plus a recovery correlation on unitaries cannot force uniqueness of Umegaki or establish DPI for a family.

Finite_modular_identity.measured_claim_that_survives: For selected full-rank qubit pairs the scalar -<vec(sqrt(rho)), log(L_sigma R_rho^{-1}) vec(sqrt(rho))> numerically agrees with Umegaki relative entropy; the swapped modular operator fails to agree; singular sigma is flagged as outside the tested regime.
Finite_modular_identity.strongest_kill: Only selected full-rank pairs are examined; no general identity, no BKM metric extraction, no thermal-time construction, and no uniqueness argument are implemented.
Finite_modular_identity.theorem_gap: The computation supports only a finite-dimensional numerical identity between a relative-modular expression and Umegaki on full-rank qubits; all further links remain prose.

response.joint_claim_that_survives: Concrete numerical residuals, agreements and non-violations on low-dimensional, hand-selected examples (Jordan residuals, 1-parameter radius-entropy correlation, BKM-Hessian difference ~1e-7, 200-sample DPI check, modular-Umegaki scalar agreement) with no universal quantifiers, no geometric constructions and no forcing.
merges_explicitly_refused: modular flow / Connes-Rovelli thermal time / unique forcing
response.deepest_real_dual_ratchet_rung: numerical agreement of the relative-modular scalar expression with Umegaki relative entropy on selected full-rank qubit pairs

next_three_decisive_sims.finite_object: full set of left-multiplication commutators on a fixed basis of H3(O) together with an explicit residual-normalization convention
next_three_decisive_sims.positive: rank of the linear span equals the expected dimension of the derivation algebra and every residual remains below a scale-invariant threshold
next_three_decisive_sims.negative: rank strictly less than expected or residual exceeds threshold after normalization
next_three_decisive_sims.boundary: generators restricted to a Cartan or to pure imaginary octonions
next_three_decisive_sims.demotion_condition: any failure of span rank or any residual that grows under rescaling of the basis

next_three_decisive_sims.finite_object: two-parameter family of pure bipartite states with generic Schmidt coefficients plus finite-difference parallel transport of the reduced Bloch vector
next_three_decisive_sims.positive: closed loops produce a holonomy matrix whose deviation from identity is independent of parametrization speed
next_three_decisive_sims.negative: holonomy is pure gauge or vanishes identically once reparametrization is allowed
next_three_decisive_sims.boundary: degeneration to product states or to maximally entangled states
next_three_decisive_sims.demotion_condition: absence of a reparametrization-invariant holonomy or reduction to a pure radius difference

next_three_decisive_sims.finite_object: finite-difference Christoffel symbols of the BKM metric on a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold of full-rank qubit states
next_three_decisive_sims.positive: Riemann tensor components computed from the Christoffel symbols are nonzero and match the known analytic formula for the BKM metric
next_three_decisive_sims.negative: all Riemann components vanish or depend on the coordinate chart after transformation
next_three_decisive_sims.boundary: approach to the pure-state boundary where the metric degenerates
next_three_decisive_sims.demotion_condition: failure to obtain a nonzero, chart-independent Riemann tensor

response.claim_ceiling: Bounded, example-level numerical diagnostics in finite dimensions; no theorems, no uniqueness statements, no Lie-algebra generation, and no geometric structures (connection, curvature, flux, shells) are established.
blocked_consumers: any claim of dynamical non-correspondence or f4 generation from Alfsen-Shultz residuals
any geometric or topological claim of shells or flux on Schmidt orbits
any assertion that BKM supplies a connection or intrinsic curvature
any uniqueness or forcing claim for Umegaki among quasi-entropies
any identification of the modular identity with thermal time, modular flow, or terrain provenance
theorem provers or physics papers treating the package as proof
